title: IEEE IV 2027 — 38th Intelligent Vehicles Symposium
note: Notification Jan 15, 2027 — lands inside your interview window, so an acceptance is citable on campus visits. Best topical fit for CAV.

title: Tri-continental SI — Informal and Shared Mobility
org: Transp. Res. Interdisciplinary Perspectives / ATS journals
note: Matches shared mobility + equity. Submission does not require attending, but the CFP PDF is the only place the deadline appears — check it this week.

title: ISTTT 27 — Int'l Symposium on Transportation and Traffic Theory
org: Univ. of Queensland / Univ. of Sydney
note: Two-stage: the Jan 2027 extended abstract is the real gate; full paper not until Aug 2027. Miss the abstract and the whole symposium closes. Most prestigious theory venue in the field.

title: TR Part D SI — AI-Driven Modelling for Transportation Resilience under Disasters
note: Matches resilience/climate + AI/ML. Date could not be confirmed on elsevier.com — verify on the journal's Editorial Manager page before relying on it.

title: IEEE ITSC 2027 — Intelligent Transportation Systems Conference
note: Submissions open Dec 1, 2026. Special session and workshop proposals also due Mar 1 / Feb 1 — organising one is a visible service line for a TT application.

title: INFORMS Annual Meeting 2027 — TSL track
note: Abstract-only, so low CV weight, but high visibility with the OR/analytics faculty who sit on search committees. Inferred from the Apr 15 2026 / Apr 17 2025 pattern. The standalone triennial TSL conference next runs ~2029.

title: TRB Annual Meeting 2028
note: 2028 cycle not yet announced; inferred from TRB's fixed Jul 1 open / Aug 1 close pattern. TRB 2027 closed Aug 1, 2026 — already past. This is your first post-defense TRB.

title: TRISTAN XIII — Triennial Symposium on Transportation Analysis
event: Porto de Galinhas, Brazil · May 28 – Jun 2, 2028
note: Submissions open Jul 12, 2027. Dates taken from the First CFP PDF, whose date labels are jumbled, and the official site still says details are forthcoming — reconfirm closer to the time.

title: Automated Transportation Symposium (ATS) 2027
note: Series moved from TRB to SAE and was renamed, which is why the scan lost track of it. ATS2025 took poster proposals ~3 months out, so expect a call around Apr 2027. Practitioner-heavy, strong for CAV networking.
